wolbi.certainty: Market supply shift inferred from daily prices, not a verified first-unlock date.
wolbi.text: Wolbi became available through the Kerning citizenship shop as players reached the required rank. The feed median fell from 19,999 on Oct 24 to 7,999 on Oct 25 and 3,648 on Oct 26. This supply change can resemble deflation. Rank 3 / Helpful Stranger is reported; max citizenship is not required. The exact first eligible date remains unverified.

indexSpecification.name: Capped base-expenditure price index
indexSpecification.selectionMetric: sum(daily median price * recorded sold volume)
indexSpecification.basePrice: base expenditure proxy / base recorded sold volume
indexSpecification.formula: 100 * sum(fixed capped base expenditure weight * current daily median / fixed base price)
indexSpecification.missingPricePolicy: last source daily median with volume >= 5; observed coverage reported separately
indexSpecification.quantityCaveat: Source recorded sold volume; transaction, lot and stack-unit semantics are not independently verified.
indexSpecification.turnoverCaveat: Daily median times recorded volume is an estimated turnover proxy, not summed trade expenditure.

historyNote: Historical values are reconstructed using this fixed basket and its dated source medians; they are not contemporaneously published observations.

reportedNxHistory.label: NiaDB published player-reported NX indicator
reportedNxHistory.methodology: Publisher indicator from player-posted market records and fixed-NX Cash Shop items; separate from our scanner-sale estimate.
reportedNxHistory.limitations: No intraday source clock or cross-provider deduplication; missing dates are gaps; October 14 is explicitly trailing 24 hours.

indexSpecification.name: Experimental capped base-expenditure cash-price index
indexSpecification.selectionMetric: all configured cash items with at least one qualifying base-period day
indexSpecification.basePrice: sum(daily median * recorded volume) / sum(recorded volume)
indexSpecification.formula: 100 * sum(fixed capped base expenditure weight * current daily median / fixed base price)
indexSpecification.missingPricePolicy: carry qualified price only after observed; index unavailable until all members priced
indexSpecification.quantityCaveat: Recorded source volume; daily median times volume is estimated expenditure, not exact trade value.
